mappings.note: Four parts spread across three outcomes: what an ion is and how a cation differs from an anion (LO-39), the charges on Mg2+ and Cl- (LO-41), and the formula MgCl2 from those valencies (LO-42). The most genuinely three-code item in the chapter.

Rahul's open flask loses mass and a friend concludes matter was destroyed. This is LO-49's question posed as a narrative, and the correction - escaping CO2 - is its answer. Not LO-39: the item diagnoses a flawed setup rather than planning a sound one.
Asteroid ice against Pacific water, both at 1:8, with a decomposition calculation. Constant proportions applied across sources, LO-40; the bare 1:8 recall items sit on LO-48.

Parts 1 to 3 are the sodium carbonate mass balance solved for sodium acetate (LO-39's verification clause); part 4 asks which Dalton postulate supports the law (LO-40). The Dalton part is what distinguishes this from the otherwise identical 9c466b2f.

Plastic blocks pulled apart and recombined to model a reaction. The postulates named are Dalton's (LO-40), while the modelling idea that matter is built from unbreakable particles is LO-48. C5.2 was considered and rejected - this is a classroom analogy, not a case study of science in human life.

Atomicity across O2, O3, He and S8 requires telling atoms from molecules (LO-39); the closing part, why most atoms do not exist independently, is the driver for compound formation (LO-40). Atomicity itself is named in no outcome in this frame.

The covalent chemistry is LO-40, but the stem explicitly casts the two oxygen atoms as 'acting like a team to survive in nature'. That is LO-45, 'relate atomic bonding to social bonding', and this is the only question in all 213 that earns it - every other bonding item is stated without a social analogy.

Naming PCl3, CS2 and SF6 by the prefix system, plus the -ide rule. LO-42's convention clause. LO-44 was considered for the factory setting and rejected: the context is hazard labelling, not the beneficial application the outcome describes.

The ionic transfer itself is LO-40. LO-44 is added because the stem turns on two dangerous elements becoming an edible substance - a beneficial application of atomic combination carrying the item's framing rather than decorating it.

Criss-cross formulae for magnesium hydroxide and calcium carbonate (LO-42) set in the preparation of a medicine, which is LO-44's named example of a beneficial application. Without the pharmacy framing this would be LO-42 alone, like ce5efb92.

Grease in petrol against copper sulfate in water, then a conductivity test in two states. Solubility and conductivity used together to separate covalent from ionic - LO-39, and the vocational setting adds no second outcome.

Define molecular mass and compute it for CH4 and HNO3. Straight LO-41. LO-44 was considered for the climate-modelling frame and rejected: the calculation serves a research simulation on another planet, not the beneficial application LO-44 describes.

(a) writes KCl and Na2SO4 from valencies (LO-42), (b) and (c) compute their formula unit masses (LO-41), and the whole item exists to size fertiliser nutrient content for a farmer, which is LO-44's beneficial-application clause. All three codes are load-bearing.
